discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology has transformed treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity, with large cardiovascular and renal outcome benefits. The work has won the Lasker, Breakthrough, Gairdner and Princess of Asturias awards, and it is widely tipped as a mature, high-impact Nobel candidate.
